'''Level 1''' was the lowest level depth on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and was deemed inhospitable.<ref name="Trivia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Concept art shows that this could have been a possible location for ''[[Star Wars: 1313]]'', a cancelled action/adventure game that was under development by LucasArts.
